subject: Payluma pricing CTA follow-up — confirm demo timing and scope
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@payluma.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested via pricing page — demo + budget context

Hi Ben,

I filled out the pricing CTA on your site — my company (Payluma) is evaluating inference providers for a pilot. We have a conservative budget for Q3 but strong interest in improving latency and token cost.

Would love to schedule a short demo focused on:
- typical cost per 1M tokens for small-medium workloads
- latency options for 50–200req/sec patterns
- deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated) given compliance needs

Prefer 30 minutes. My availability next week:
- Tue 6/22 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 6/23 14:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 6/25 09:00–11:00 PT

If you have a quick slot that works I can confirm. Happy to share a short doc about our expected traffic.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform
Payluma
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@payluma.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested via pricing page — demo + budget context

Alex — thanks for the note and for filling out the pricing CTA. Appreciate the context.

Looping in Marissa (AE) — she can run the demo and align on pricing & procurement. I can join the call to cover typical throughput/cost trade-offs.

Marissa — Payluma is a budgeted pilot looking at latency and unit economics. Alex listed Tue/Wed/Fri windows above. Can you propose 2x 30-min slots? We usually send a Calendly link but happy to match their windows.

Alex — I pulled your record into our CRM: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4829. If you can share the short doc on expected traffic that would be helpful.

Proposed quick agenda for 30m:
1) 5m intros + goals
2) 10m demo (hosted vs dedicated differences)
3) 10m pricing/next steps
4) 5m Q/A and logistics (security/compliance checklist)

If that works I’ll send an invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Alex Turner <alex@payluma.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested via pricing page — demo + budget context

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reply. The Tue morning slot is tight for us — would you be able to do:
- Thu 6/24 11:00–11:30 PT
- Fri 6/25 10:00–10:30 PT

Also can you include an SE — we want to ask fairly specific questions about KV caching and expected latency at cold-start.

I attached a 1-page traffic snapshot (inline below) — small bursty workload, ~120 req/sec peak, average payload 600 tokens. Our pilot budget is ~USD 15k for proof-of-concept.

Let me know which slot you can lock. If neither fits we can do an internal swap and propose another time.

Cheers,
Alex

--
Traffic snapshot: Peak 120r/s, average 45r/s, synchronous inference, retention of KV per session: 10–20s.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@payluma.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested via pricing page — demo + budget context

Alex — thanks for the snapshot, that’s helpful. We can take the 30-min demo on Fri 6/25 at 10:00 PT.

Joining: me (AE), Ben (SDR), Lukas Meyer (Solutions Eng) — Lukas will cover KV cache patterns and cold-start behavior. Invite sent: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min?month=2026-06

Attached for prep: Redwood-demo-agenda.docx (brief agenda), SOW-template.pdf (for procurement visibility), Payluma-pricing-notes.xlsx (a starter pricing worksheet).

Confirming agenda:
- 5m: introductions + pilot goals
- 12m: focused demo on caching/throughput options
- 8m: high-level pricing & options for a $15k pilot
- 5m: immediate next steps & timeline

If you need us to run a short in-product trace prior to the call, share a sample API request and we’ll validate expected latencies.

See you Friday — will send a calendar invite with dial-in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood-demo-agenda.docx, SOW-template.pdf, Payluma-pricing-notes.xlsx
